_about: PRACTICE (8 Nov 2026): finish-the-sentence prompts for skills/writing/practice.html. Every prompt is a phrase from the bank (data/writing/cue-generator.json) with {t} where a topic the student knows goes ({T} = capitalised, {k} = what kind of thing it is). Each prompt stops where the student's own words begin; ex shows one finished sentence about its own topic. For reports, no is a chatty ending to avoid.
